source: PC thermometer: the level's angrytime=156 in the PC data (level_bath/level.xml, 1/20 s ticks) is the 7.8 s the mercury takes to drain from full — tools/pcref/thermo.py measured the same off the video; PCThermometerDrain 12.82 %/s is the HUD's drawing rate only, the tick meter keeps the mobile data's AngryMeterDecay (docs/PC_FIDELITY.md §7). PC lap (docs/PC_LAPS.md): his album spell is 19 s on E06 against the mobile's 12 — the read is five 0.54 s PhotoAlbumLoop entries (2.7 s) between Start and End; eighteen make the 9.7 s read that spans 19 with the walk. PC per-trick angrytime (tricks.xml: foambottle 240, dirtytowel 216; 1/20 s): the anger indicator holds at its maximum that long after the trick — the thermometer's long holds on the video (E14's marbles 18.1 s, E09's 12.6, E05's 14.6) — carried as PCAngryTime for the profile's hold (docs/PC_FIDELITY.md §7).
